queries.name: sql_identity_readonly
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS db_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, CURRENT_USER AS current_user_name

queries.name: security_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Usuario%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%User%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Permiso%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Menu%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Empresa%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Unidad%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: security_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Usuario%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%User%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Permiso%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Menu%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME

objective: Auditar en modo SQL solo lectura la base canonica para diagnosticar acceso al menu Usuarios en Produccion: usuarios, roles, permisos, EmpresaID, UnidadNegocioID, menus y RBAC. Sin DML, sin DDL, sin deploy.
